$Comment: The ghostly sheen every creature of the Turkey Graveyard wears: the game's own Spectator model effect, a pale blue wash over the whole body, the one the game puts on a player watching as a spectator. The Turkey Souls and the Great Turkey wear it from the moment they rise, through their roles' _CombatConfig EntityEffects (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul.json and Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey.json under NPC/Roles/Harvest_Feast), and it lasts until they fall. It changes nothing but the look, shows no tile and needs no name. ModelVFXId is any model effect under the game's Entity/ModelVFX.
